# Frankie & Fanucci's

> Frankie & Fanucci's is a bustling, casual pizzeria located in Mamaroneck, New York. The restaurant serves authentic Neapolitan thin-crust pies cooked in a wood-fired oven, alongside a variety of pasta, salads, and other Italian fare.

## Menu
Frankie & Fanucci's offers a menu centered around authentic Neapolitan pizza, cooked in a wood-fired oven. Beyond pizza, they serve classic Italian appetizers, salads, pasta dishes, and main courses, with options for gluten-free and vegan diners.
